_comment: Spark Hermes local scoring intent for a proposed SN74 / Gittensor integration. This documentary file does not register the repository, establish merged-PR eligibility or authorize payout. External onboarding and the subnet-controlled registry and reward policy govern live eligibility and payments.
scoring: Proposed local tier intent: fixed_base_score (1.0) times the quality tier label, with training eval tiers twice dataset tiers at the same letter and an initial verified checkpoint tier of 2.0. These values are not verified live subnet configuration or a payout guarantee. CPU fixtures establish software behavior only.

label_multipliers._comment: Local proposed multipliers retained for compatibility; verify repository approval and the current subnet-controlled registry before claiming any live reward eligibility.

non_quality_prs: Public reusable tooling, benchmarks, docs and refactors are welcome. This local quality-tier proposal assigns no model-quality credit to them; their actual external reward eligibility is determined by the subnet. The eval/scoring harness is maintainer-owned (see CONTRIBUTING.md).

areas._comment: Categorization only - drives the deterministic area:* labels for display, NOT emission weights.
areas.teacher: teacher-trajectory generation, sampling, and provider integrations
areas.recipes: Axolotl training recipes - data mix, hyperparameters, adapter config
areas.eval: benchmark harness + eval scoring + cheap proof verification (harness scripts are maintainer-owned)
areas.proof: GPU confidential-computing attestation + Hugging Face proof-bundle packaging/publishing

notes: Maturity-adaptive tiering is local scoring intent. Upstream policy and onboarding must be checked independently: https://github.com/gittensor-ai-lab . Private derived model artifacts remain subject to upstream licenses and data grants. No measured learning, repository registration or live payout is established by this file.
